Dear Hush Puppies Customer Service Team,

 I hope this msg finds you well. I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration regarding a recent experience I had with your company's customer service, as well as the quality of one of your products. 

 As a longtime loyal customer of Hush Puppies, I have always been impressed by the quality and comfort of your shoe line. However, a recent incident has severely tarnished my opinion of the brand. Approximately six+ months ago, I purchased a pair of Hush Puppies shoes, the "Gibbs" model, from your Packages Mall outlet in Lahore, Pakistan. 

After bringing them to Australia and wearing them for some time, I noticed that the shoes began to deteriorate, failing to meet the high standards of quality I have come to expect from Hush Puppies products. 

Despite having paid Rs. 20,000 for the shoes, they failed to hold up as promised. In accordance with the brand's promise to service shoes experiencing quality issues, I took the shoes to your MM Alam branch for servicing. 

However, I was met with rude and dismissive behavior from your staff, who informed me that nothing could be done to repair the shoes. Despite my insistence and explanation of my loyalty to the brand, my concerns were brushed aside, leaving me feeling deeply disheartened. It is unacceptable for a brand with such a reputation for quality and customer service to treat its loyal customers in this manner. 

I believe that Hush Puppies should take ownership of this issue and honor its commitment to ensuring customer satisfaction. I have provided the contact details of the person in charge, Mr. Mateen (at the lahore factory) along with the claim reference number for your convenience. Mr. Mateen has straight forwardly refused to service my claim and offered absolutely no assistance.
Is this how Hush puppies treat its customer and provide after sale service? 
How Hushpuppies is allowing such rudimentary unhelpful behaviour is beyond my understanding.  

-Claim reference number: RC-047790
-Mr Mateen Contact number: 0322-418511

 I urge you to address this matter promptly and either repair my shoes to the standard they were meant to meet or compensate me with a new pair.

 I have come from Australia on my leave and brought the pair of shoes with me to get it repaired from the brand  in order to maintain its quality and structural integrity. 
My return flight is on 5th of May Sunday , and i need this matter resolved at earlier than my departure date
 
Unless this issue is resolved satisfactorily, I regret to inform you that I will no longer be able to support the Hush Puppies brand. 

I sincerely hope that you will take this matter seriously and take the necessary steps to rectify the situation. 

Alternatively, please align me with one of the senior management so i can take this matter with them. 
 
Thank you for your attention to this matter. 

Thanks
